klipler.istem: The bee slowly moves its antennae and gently flicks its wings while standing still on the arm. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears. Exactly six legs.
Slow camera glide along the barbed stinger, light glints on each barb. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
The tiny venom sac pulses gently and slowly, the nerve knot glows softly. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
